title: The $H^{2|2}$ monotonicity theorem revisited
summary: We use supersymmetric localization and integration by parts to derive variational and convex correlation inequalities in statistical physics. As a primary application, we give an alternative proof of the monotonicity theorem for the $H^{2|2}$ supersymmetric hyperbolic sigma model. This extends a result of Poudevigne to a stronger multivariate convex comparison inequality, without relying on probabilistic couplings.
